package_info.package_versions: malicious version (exact version not specified in report)
package_info.why_malicious: A malicious version of the 'conventional-changelog' npm package was uploaded, as announced in a security advisory. The package is considered malicious due to the presence of unauthorized or harmful code introduced in the compromised version.

behavioral_signatures: Unexpected changes in package behavior after update
Presence of code in package versions not present in legitimate upstream releases
Network requests or credential access in changelog-related packages
file_indicators: conventional-changelog package files differing from official repository
Unexpected scripts in package.json or new JavaScript files
network_indicators: Outbound network requests from changelog generation scripts
Connections to unknown or suspicious domains
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for installation or use of the 'conventional-changelog' npm package at the affected version(s). Compare package contents to the official upstream repository to identify unauthorized code. Flag any network activity or credential access initiated by this package. Use software composition analysis tools to identify applications depending on the malicious version.
